text:
The handle of a metal cooking pan is made from wood.
What is a reason for making the handle from wood?
A
to increase thermal energy transfer by conduction
B
to increase thermal energy transfer by convection
C
to reduce thermal energy transfer by conduction
D
to reduce thermal energy transfer by convection

options.label: A
options.text: to increase thermal energy transfer by conduction

options.label: B
options.text: to increase thermal energy transfer by convection

options.label: C
options.text: to reduce thermal energy transfer by conduction

options.label: D
options.text: to reduce thermal energy transfer by convection

subject: Physics
